attestations.note: The life page `/2797/` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 26 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **No `dates` object is drafted, because the page's own two dating clauses cannot both stand.** It brings him to Constantinople «επί Λέοντος του Ισαύρου (813 - 820 μ.Χ.)» — the years are those of Leo V the Armenian and the by-name is the page's own slip — and then has the patrician Bryennios, who was keeping him, sent as ambassador to the Bulgarians «από τη βασίλισσα Θεοδώρα», the empress Theodora, whose regency is a generation later. The page gives his age at death, seventy-nine, and no year. It names Galatia as his origin, Skopelos where he met the elder who tonsured him, the Monastery of Stoudios where he shone as a strict ascetic, and the monastery of Kokourouvion, or Kokkorovion, where his relic was laid; no coordinate is proposed. He is not `evaristus-of-the-ten-of-crete`, a martyr of the Greek 23 December. No hymn. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (2 October 2026).
